description: The case's own action types (engine/actions.js has the generic ones): each `{id, label, requires, effects}` in the action table's rule shape, its roles `$agent`, `$thing`, `$to`, `$item`, `$about`, `$via`, `$where`. `ramifies`: what a goal's state brings with it, `{if: {attr, value}, then: {attr, value}}` of the same thing (a horse injured before its race loses it).
